required_runtime: Actual current controller code in cross-DO workerd SQLite storage; synthetic clock/provider; excluded driver; no public HTTP during scheduled recovery phase.
case_fields: Fault boundaries name candidate hooks to add. Required observations must be asserted against durable storage and independently observable provider/claim call history, not a model self-report.

cases.setup: Fresh valid A identity; no operation row or registry record.
actions: Issue authenticated A ensure; interrupt registry durability before ACK.
Restart both DOs and read exact storage.
required: No operation row/effect/provider call/claim before durable registration acknowledgement.
At most one pending A registry record; uncertain registration result cannot authorize work.

cases.setup: Fresh A.
actions: Drop registration ACK; retry same identity after restart.
required: Same stable record ID, allocation index, shard and identity bytes.
One permanent allocation; no double operation or launch.

cases.setup: A registered at tracked version 0.
actions: Kill operation; disable public HTTP and operation alarms.
Invoke scheduled audit twice; later issue independent valid authenticated A command.
required: Scheduled recovery returns empty_orphan without creating an operation row/effect/guard.
A stays pending and occupies its permanent slot.
Later command must independently pass current immutable/guard/clock checks.

cases.setup: A pre-registered; local intent and outbox committed.
actions: Kill workerd before track/alarm; restart with public HTTP disabled and alarm set/retries faulted.
Invoke only independent scheduled event.
required: A is found through earlier durable registration.
Existing outbox/intent replayed; no new authority fabricated.
Provider call can occur only after durable intent barrier plus current final authority check.

cases.setup: A local intent version 9007199254740993; registry accepts its exact projection.
actions: Drop ACK; restart and replay outbox.
required: Exact equal-version retry returns duplicate.
No number rounding; local outbox clears only matching exact version/projection.

cases.setup: A outbox v9007199254740993 in flight; newer command writes v9007199254740994.
actions: Deliver older ACK after newer outbox commit; flush newest.
required: Old ACK cannot erase new outbox.
Registry and local ACK watermarks never decrease.

cases.setup: Registry holds exact A v9007199254740994 projection.
actions: Send older version, equal-version changed projection, then same-key different identity/hash/generation.
required: Older request is stale without mutation.
Equal-version conflict and identity conflict fail closed; no second allocation or provider call.

cases.setup: Registry holds A positive version above restored local row.
actions: Call recoverKnown and ordinary authenticated command.
required: Retained registry watermark is not overwritten.
Operation is quarantined; no launch/claim or reconstruction of clock history.

cases.setup: A prepared launch/claim has exact registry barrier version.
actions: Change owner/revision/desired stop, immutable identity or qualified clock while awaiting barrier.
Release and attempt final dispatch/grant.
required: Every changed current authority/identity/time check denies new launch/grant.
Clock-only final history write creates later outbox without an infinite flush/sample loop.
Claim has no await after final current-state transaction/output gate.

cases.setup: Registered A with durable launch-dispatched marker.
actions: Kill before call, after call and after remote effect in separate fresh fixtures.
Audit recovery with provider initially absent then delayed inert/running.
required: Never clear launch_dispatched or launch a replacement.
Reconcile original identity only; retain ambiguity until sufficient proof.

cases.setup: A inert supervisor with unissued claim.
actions: Lose registry ACK or crash; retry claim after restart; then deliver stop.
required: No grant before consumed-claim barrier ACK and V2 final current identity/time check.
Consumed claim is never reset and lost grant never produces second grant.
Audit itself never calls claim.

cases.setup: A already registered with committed desired stop and owned unresolved work; clock unqualified.
actions: Invoke alarm and identity-only audit recovery.
Restore registry; flush stop/terminal outbox.
required: Committed stop still reaches original provider cleanup with unavailable registry/clock.
No launch/claim/result acceptance or capacity release derives from registry.
Definitive terminal still requires unchanged descendants/ticket drain proof.

cases.setup: Fresh B identity; registry unavailable.
actions: Issue B first stop; recover registry and retry under independently live guard.
required: No initial operation row/effect before preregistration.
After registration, persisted stop is permanent and ensure cannot reopen it.

cases.setup: A terminal accepted only after definitive drain; local terminal outbox committed.
actions: Crash at both boundaries in fresh fixtures; restart/audit; issue later ensure/query.
required: Registry remains pending until matching terminal track commits.
Terminal digest uses exact local durable bytes and no result body enters registry.
Terminal receipt/identity/operation safety state remain permanent; no reactivation.

cases.setup: A wake in flight, then newer permanent terminal track commits.
actions: Deliver old pending/failed wake reply and higher-version nonterminal track.
required: No old reply or newer nonterminal projection can reopen quiescent terminal identity.
Terminal state and retention slot remain unchanged.

cases.setup: All 16 buckets have >32 pending identities; mixed quiet terminal records, attention rows and allocations at 1/4096.
actions: Invoke repeated scheduled runs with no public HTTP; capture each durable cursor.
Interrupt runs after a partial page and restart.
required: At most 32 records/65536 bytes per page and no duplicates within page wrap.
Only examined rows advance per-shard cursor; shards rotate before any hot shard drains.
Every pending identity is eventually visited in a fixed progressing population; attention is included.

cases.setup: At least nine eligible records on first shard and eligible records on every other shard.
actions: Invoke one scheduled run then another.
required: First run starts at most eight recovery RPCs and at most 16 pages/512 examinations.
Ninth record is retained for a later fair visit, with next shard persisted.
Counters include failed and timed-out starts.

cases.setup: Maximum legal canonical identities and closed delivery metadata; enough records to exceed byte cap before 32.
actions: Read a page and continue from last examined index.
required: Encoded page never exceeds 65536 bytes; no unbounded toArray/all-registry scan.
Byte truncation cannot skip unreturned/unexamined rows or break wrap fairness.

cases.setup: One fixed coordinator; A scan version in flight.
actions: Invoke concurrent duplicate schedule; advance A track version while old reservation reply is held.
Restart coordinator and deliver old reservation completion.
required: Live coordinator starts one unresolved wake/run; duplicate invocation reports busy.
Durable run/reservation CAS rejects stale completion.
Interrupted run remains a receipt; no assumption old RPC was cancelled; duplicate recovery cannot duplicate launch/grant.

cases.setup: A recovery keeps failing or returns empty_orphan; other records progress.
actions: Run enough fair visits to cross failure 8 and saturate 32, then recover A.
required: needs_attention set at eight, failures saturate32, skip_visits bounded0..7.
A remains pending and attempts automatically resume at least every eighth visit.
Recovery needs no customer request or manual safety-state reset; successful delivery resets delivery backoff.
scan_due is read-only for delivery/backoff metadata; only reserve_wake decrements skip_visits once per run/record; duplicate scans/reservations cannot double decrement.

cases.setup: First wake promise ignores cancellation and remains unresolved; at least eight other eligible records.
actions: Invoke audit; expire 2500ms caller wait; observe until budget completion then settle held task.
required: No second wake starts in that invocation while task unresolved.
Timeout is unknown, not cancellation proof; bounded receipt/attention and retained pending identity.
Owned task cleanup is independently observed or explicitly failed, never reported as clean from timeout alone.
All page/reserve/finish waits count toward the same24000ms invocation budget; reserve/finish timeout retains pending/unknown reservation, never fabricated cancellation or success.

cases.setup: One fixed shard unavailable; others have pending operations, including committed stops.
actions: Run schedules across wrap; restore shard and repeat.
required: Failed shard row cursor retained; next-shard cursor advances; other shards progress.
Failed registration/track cannot authorize new effect/grant.
Restored shard's pending records remain discoverable without customer HTTP.

cases.setup: Synthetic valid identities selected for one canonical shard, using fixed actual limit4096.
actions: Register4096 identities; retry last; register4097th new identity.
Audit existing records, terminal replay and committed-stop recovery at capacity.
required: First4096 permanent slots allocated once; duplicate registration succeeds without allocation.
4097th fails before operation allocation/mutation; no arbitrary/fallback shard.
No eviction/TTL/delete/reuse; existing audit/stop/terminal behavior continues.

cases.setup: Source-bound ASCII/Unicode/quoting identities plus deterministic fixtures for first hex digits0..f.
actions: Recompute current operationKey and versioned identity tuple; request caller-selected shard/generation variations.
required: All16 buckets map exactly from first lowercase operationKey nibble.
Same immutable key conflicting bytes rejected; no normalization or float conversion.
Unknown/missing keys/oversize fields and caller shard routing rejected.

cases.setup: Registry A tracked positive version, operation row missing; separate B version0 orphan.
actions: Recover A and B; issue later A command.
required: A gets bounded persistent quarantine fence without synthetic operation/guard; new work unavailable.
B returns empty_orphan and remains pending; neither wake creates an operation.

cases.setup: A consumed claim/stop in current namespace; registry or operation generation differs or storage rolled back.
actions: Attempt scheduled recovery, registered command and enrollment.
required: No fallback namespace, reset, replacement or quarantine clearing.
Matching two restored copies is not claimed nonrollbackable authority.
Original safety identities retained; independent restore authority remains pending.

cases.setup: Actual schema1/schema2 rows covering terminal, desired stop, launch-dispatched and consumed claim states.
actions: Migrate to3 and explicitly enroll known matching identities; attempt enrollment of missing/wrong identity.
required: Preserve every V2 clock-floor/safety/result field; quarantine new effects.
Existing stop can still enforce cleanup; enrollment cannot clear quarantine or create missing row.
No namespace enumeration or claimed complete legacy discovery.

cases.setup: Registered A pending intent with stale/expiry-boundary/backward/unqualified clock cases.
actions: Audit/recover then independently request claim.
required: No registry projection/ticket changes lease/clock floor or grants authority.
All frozen V2 final-time/rollback behaviors remain; definite deadline stop only under existing lower-bound rule.

cases.setup: State/run/wake TEXT sequence at9223372036854775807; failure counter32.
actions: Try transitions/reservation/run; inspect restart state.
required: Overflow fails closed without wrap, erasure, replacement identity or partial SQL commit.
Failure counter remains32; permanent pending/terminal safety record retained with attention.

cases.setup: Candidate production build and excluded three-class fixture runtime.
actions: Run existing20 identity controls and71 controller groups plus all registry cases.
Audit compiled import closure, credentials/source sinks and owned storage/tasks/processes/EOF.
required: No new dependency or test clock/provider/control in production import closure.
Every command/source/output/time/version/cleanup is bound in fresh receipt.
No unrelated process/storage mutation; deployed/provider/clock/restore/native/GA gates remain unpassed.
